judgment.notes: Compared the complete inspected AuditBExport.P with H001–H006 and source D001–D007. Natural dimensions constrained ≥1 encode precisely the admissible integer dimensions. WM.X is standard real coordinates; its sup norm changes neither finite-dimensional smoothness nor compactness, and its product volume is Lebesgue measure. WM.Y is EuclideanSpace with Euclidean norms. The total-time parameter imposes smoothness only on the open set t>0: extension by q outside it and restriction preserve all positive-time derivative germs, including iterated partials. WM.dt, dx, utt and lap are the stated partials and componentwise Laplacian under H002. H005 retains a pointwise existential scalar without regularity, and H006 retains a single compact set for each positive closed slab and the fixed q. WM.e has exactly the squared Euclidean time norm plus the coordinate sum, with no half factor; energy is its spatial integral. All four target clauses occur explicitly, including integrability, differentiability, ordinary zero derivative, and equality for any positive s,t; no time-zero condition. Read all local predicate fields: regularity, integrability and localData are proved by T002–T004 and assembled, not hidden hypotheses of P. The slice/joint derivative bridge in T002 and coordinate-insertion measure/integral conversion in T010–T011 are actual checked code.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
